run_c3_image_experiment: run the C3 per data-point image compression experiment via jaxline platform with a config file
fit_datum_train_params: train C3 model parameters on a single image using noise quantization followed by STE refinement
eval_image_compression_metrics: evaluate a trained C3 model on an image and return PSNR, SSIM, distortion, and rate metrics
search_quantization_steps: search over quantization step values for weights and biases to find the best rate-distortion tradeoff
count_latent_variables: count the total number of latent variables for a given input resolution using the Experiment class
